title.narrative: Functionalization of the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences of the University of Prishtina

description.narrative: This is a EU funded project for the construction of new premises for the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences of the University of Pristina in Kosovo, with design and construction that aims to provide modern, safe, inclusive and environmentally friendly facilities for all. \nThe objective of this project is to support the Ministry, respectively the University of Pristina to improve quality standards and inclusivity, enhance research capacities and promote gender and environmental friendly facilities in Higher Education Institutions through the development and construction of modern educational facilities.\n
